summary: Copies approach slides from a real proposal template so the generated proposal keeps the original design, then fills the copies with new text. Only the setup section was visible in the packet.
purpose: Keep original formatting, shapes and layouts by copying template slides instead of redrawing them.
why: The module docstring says this is the correct method and replaces an older one that built slides from scratch.
how: Open a template, find its approach slides, copy them, clear the text from text boxes, write the new content into them, and save a new presentation. Only the setup is visible, so the order is taken from the docstring.
inputs: A template presentation file, the project structure (workstreams and modules), and the output path.
outputs: A new presentation file with copied and filled approach slides.
risks: Copying slides often loses images or links unless they are handled, and that handling is not visible here. The output cannot be trusted until it is checked visually.
debug: Open the output and the template side by side. If formatting is lost, look at the copy step. If text is missing, look at the filling step.
